description: Licenses allowed for shipped (non-dev) dependencies. Anything not listed fails CI. Changing this file needs the same review as a code change.

conditional.MPL-2.0: File-level copyleft: allowed while the package's own files are used unmodified.
conditional.LGPL-3.0-only: Allowed while the library is used unmodified and dynamically linked (e.g. psycopg).
conditional.LGPL-3.0-or-later: Allowed while the library is used unmodified and dynamically linked (e.g. psycopg).
